RedWallet XBT 8.0.1 (1795014651)

Please check the Lightning Settings crash fix on iPhone. Open XBT Lightning Settings, expand or refresh a section, then go back. No payment is needed. If RedWallet closes, send the approximate time and build number through TestFlight feedback.

The built-in XBT Lightning wallet can scan a SHA256 invoice and show a Kilombino bridge quote for review. You can cancel before payment. This build also supports reusable XBT Lightning offers, an editable node name, and a short background window for the embedded node.

On Receive, native SegWit is the default and Taproot is available. The hardware signer check uses a request that cannot spend funds.
